pairs.question: si ascendam ad Philistheos si trades eos in manu mea
pairs.answer: ascende et tradam eos in manu tua
pairs.derivation: David consults God (deliberative question introduced by 'consuluitque David Deum dicens', dropped as a speech tag). The question is David's two-part deliberative 'si ascendam... si trades...'. The Lord's reply, introduced by the dropped tag 'et dixit ei Dominus', directly answers both clauses: 'ascende et tradam eos in manu tua'. The answer is the whole reply (one sentence).
